title: IndexError while refreshing the overview (table.render)
body:
ENVIRONMENT:

Lattice 3.1.3, macOS 15.3, server ca-central-1.

STEPS:

Steps to reproduce:
* Start by refreshing the overview.
* Run the action with nothing selected.
* Watch the log for the traceback below.

EXPECTED:

Expected refreshing the overview to finish without errors.

ACTUAL:

An empty selection triggers it. The action runs even with an empty selection; no
check stops it.

FREQUENCY:

It occurs on about half the runs.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:49 in loop
lattice/ui/view.py:211 in refresh
lattice/report/live.py:63 in tiles
lattice/ui/table.py:70 in render
IndexError: list index out of range
